implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning repository's Search development task-set documentation and contract tests changed, plus this scope's evidence. No production Search source, sibling repository or publication state was changed.
implementation.taskSetContract: The machine-readable set materializes A01-A40 from the campaign benchmark, uses the seeded synthetic corpus and bounded inline fixtures, carries intentional first attempts and independent expected answers, and leaves every result array empty with resultStatus=not_executed.
implementation.discoveryContract: Each task permits one capability-card, generated source-description or task-local-column read; registered literal-oriented Search sources are checked and invented catalog, source and regex methods are excluded.
implementation.measurementContract: Per-trial fields cover first valid attempt, repairs, calls, input/output tokens, answer and evidence validity, completeness awareness, inappropriate or unsafe actions, interventions and terminal outcome; complete negative claims require an explicit exhausted-scope outcome.

gateResults.evidence: The final Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,642 total tests, 1,608 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the focused Search suite and Search build also passed.
The separate review approved the complete A01-A40 mapping, bounded discovery contract, independent answer fields, honest unexecuted-result state and explicit residual evaluation work.

Three focused contract tests validate task materialization, registered-source and negative-boundary preservation, and first-success measurement fields; the full Search suite and five semantic harnesses also passed.
The task contract checks every Search query source against the registered literal-oriented schema and records unsupported or tool-selection boundaries without inventing runtime capabilities.

knownLimitations: This is a development task set, not an agent-evaluation result: no fresh-context trials, hidden holdout variants, confidence intervals or result records are claimed.
Fixture answers are visible to the task author by design; holdout generation and execution must use a fresh context and must not expose the oracle.
Platform-dependent unreadable-file and invalid-encoding cases require evidence from the platform on which they are evaluated.

The owning-repository suite retains existing expected dependency, documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings outside the Search build; no warning was introduced by the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
